alina: Quick heads-up: a customer reported that after v2 became default some of their SDKs silently get a 502/parse error. They say it happens only through an edge proxy chain.
tom: sounds like partial-body / streaming boundaries? v2 adds a small top-level `meta` object which strict parsers may choke on if the body is truncated.
rachel: I dug in the logs: lots of `EOF while parsing` and then connection resets at the edge. Many flows are HTTP/1.1 chunked.
hannah: can we do a safety parse fallback in the router that attempts lenient-json -> if that fails, route to v1? Would prefer not to force a tenant pin immediately.
alina: agreed. Proposal: try a lightweight lenient parse (ignore trailing garbage/truncated tokens) and if successful emit `compat.parse_mode=heuristic_lenient` and continue to v2. If parse fails, fallback route to v1 with telemetry reason `parse_failure`.
tom: love the telemetry. Add `compat.parse_sample_id` for sampled payload capture (1-2%) so Evals can repro. Must be PII-scrubbed.
rachel: runbook note: any fallback that routes to v1 should also create a console alert for the tenant (one-time) so customers know we silently polyfilled. We should not do silent polyfills forever.
devops-bot: rolling out: lenient-parse filter pushed to canary (3% tenants) - rollout id r-2026-03-22T08:10Z :zap:
alina: draft config for router filter:```\nfilters:\n  - name: lenient_json_parse\n    match: http.request.body\n    params:\n      sample_rate: 0.02\n      emit_telemetry: true\n      fallback_action: route_v1_if_unparseable\n      console_override: true\n```\nhannah: console_override is important. Product wants a per-tenant "Compatibility mode" switch and a small banner: "If your infra strips or truncates streaming bodies, try Compatibility Parsing (lenient). See runbook." Link to runbook.
tom: metrics to add: `compat.parse_attempts`, `compat.parse_success`, `compat.parse_fallbacks` (by tenant + reason). Dashboards: heatmap of parse_fallbacks per region and a sparklines panel for tenants with >5 fallbacks/day.
rachel: alerts: fire if `compat.parse_fallbacks` (reason=parse_failure) > 10 in 1h for any tenant, or if global parse_fail_rate > 0.5% of requests in an hour.
alina: on rollback criteria: if canary causes P95 latency regression > 20ms or we see > 5% unexpected behavior in canary tenants vs control, rollback. Also abort if sampled payloads show PII after scrub (we'll validate sampling pipeline).
devops-bot: traceability: created issue infra/lenient-parse-2026 and dashboard ticket dash/lenient-parse-telemetry.
hannah: UI copy: next to "Default API version" add a small help: "We detected edge proxies truncating responses; enable Compatibility Parsing to reduce errors". Link to runbook.
tom: make sure the implementation increments a lint-safe header `x-rw-compat-mode: lenient-json` when applied so downstream engineers can filter offline.
rachel: also add a short-lived migration email template ops can send: subject "Client errors after v2 switch - recommended mitigation" with steps: enable Compatibility Parsing OR pin tenant to v1 via Console and update SDK/proxy.
alina: I'll own the canary and telemetry dashboards. Hannah, can you add the Console toggle + banner? Tom will PR router change. Rachel, please draft runbook + email template.
console-bot: Canary rolling: lenient-parse filter enabled for canary cohort (3%) - monitor id mon-2026-03-22T08:18Z :satellite:
alina: let's regroup after 24h of canary signals. If numbers look good we'll widen to 25% and run a 6h A/B to compare error rates and latency. Thanks all :heart:
